# @sharadox/style-web-library

> Multi-group styles (themes) for React/Next.js: each group (color, corner, font…) has options with CSS-variable palettes, a default, optional "system" (prefers-color-scheme), and a remembered choice; applied pre-paint.

- defineStyles({ groups: [{ name, defaultChoice, options: [{ name, scheme?, palette }], systemDefaults?: { dark, light }, fallbackScheme?, storageKey? }] }) from `/definition` (validates)
- <StyleScript configuration={STYLES} /> in <head>, with <html suppressHydrationWarning>
- useStyle(STYLES, "color") → { choice, style, choices, choose } ("use client")
- styleChoices(group): order light options, "system", dark options (for switches)
- html attributes: data-style-<group>, data-style-<group>-choice; color-scheme set for groups with schemes
- Storage: localStorage "style-<group>" (or storageKey); choosing the default removes it
- License: Sharadox Open Source License 0.1.0
- /style-keeper StyleKeeper({ groups }) client component re-applying remembered styles on mount (rendered by StyleScript; fixes styles lost when a navigation replaces <html>, e.g. switching locale)
